facts.text: First-year students at Georgia College & State University are required to purchase a minimum campus meal plan.

sources.title: New Student Application - University Housing - Georgia College
sources.quote: Meal Plan Requirement. Freshmen are required to carry a minimum meal plan. Plans are optional for upperclassmen.
